title: Taking a booking at Café Ünïcode
purpose: Show the owner how a host takes a booking in under a minute.

intro.title: Taking a booking
intro.text: What you'll see: tonight's tables, a new booking typed in, and the confirmation.

steps.title: Tonight's tables
steps.caption: The host lands on tonight's tables, in time order.

steps.title: Start a booking
steps.caption: One link starts a new booking.

steps.title: Type the guest's name
steps.caption: The name is the only field the host has to fill in.

steps.title: Book the table
steps.caption: Your turn: book the table.
steps.hint: Not that one: press “Book the table”, the highlighted button.

steps.title: Booked
steps.caption: The booking is confirmed on the same page, with a way back.

steps.title: Back on the list
steps.caption: Tonight's list is where the host goes next, with the next booking one tap away.

closing.title: What to try next
closing.text: Open the prototype and take a booking yourself, or try the error state.
